# 1. Project Overview

Green Valley Residency is a landmark premium residential apartment community developed by Green Valley Developers Pvt. Ltd., strategically located in the heart of Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka. Conceived as a sanctuary of modern living amid the rapid urbanization of East Bengaluru, the project blends contemporary architecture, expansive green landscaping, and thoughtfully engineered infrastructure to deliver a lifestyle that balances comfort, convenience, and long-term value. The vision behind Green Valley Residency is to create a self-sufficient, community-oriented neighbourhood where families, working professionals, and investors alike can find a home that meets both everyday needs and aspirational living standards.

The architectural design draws inspiration from contemporary tropical-modern aesthetics, characterised by clean geometric lines, large glass facades for natural light, ventilated balconies, and a low-density layout that maximises open space between towers. Only 38 percent of the total land parcel is used for the built structure, while the remaining 62 percent is dedicated to landscaped gardens, walking plazas, water bodies, and recreational zones. This design philosophy ensures that residents enjoy an abundance of natural light, cross-ventilation in every apartment, and unobstructed views of greenery from most units.

Green Valley Residency is designed primarily for nuclear and joint families seeking spacious, well-ventilated homes; working professionals employed in the numerous IT parks and technology campuses of Whitefield who value proximity to their workplace; and investors looking for a property with strong rental demand and consistent capital appreciation. The community atmosphere is designed to encourage social interaction through communal courtyards, a central amphitheatre, jogging tracks, and multiple recreational clubs, while also offering complete privacy within each residence through soundproofed walls and thoughtfully staggered apartment layouts.

Sustainability is a cornerstone of the project. Green Valley Residency incorporates rainwater harvesting pits at every tower, a dedicated sewage treatment plant (STP) that recycles 100 percent of wastewater for landscaping and flushing purposes, rooftop solar panels that power all common area lighting, and a comprehensive organic waste converter that processes kitchen waste into compost for the on-site gardens. These initiatives collectively reduce the community's dependency on municipal water supply by nearly 45 percent and lower the common area electricity bill by an estimated 30 percent annually.

Security and safety have been engineered to institutional-grade standards. The entire perimeter is monitored using high-definition CCTV cameras with 90-day storage retention, biometric and RFID-based access control at all tower entrances, round-the-clock trained security personnel, and a centralised command control room. Fire safety compliance includes wet riser systems, sprinklers in all common areas and basements, smoke detectors in every apartment, fire refuge areas on alternate floors, and an automatic fire alarm system linked to the local fire department. The entire structure is designed and certified to withstand seismic activity up to Zone III standards, with reinforced shear walls and a raft foundation engineered by a certified structural consultancy.

Every apartment at Green Valley Residency comes pre-wired for smart home integration, allowing residents to control lighting, main door locks, air conditioning, and curtains through a mobile application. Video door phones are linked to the main security gate, enabling residents to grant visitor access remotely. Taken together, these features position Green Valley Residency as one of the most comprehensively planned residential communities in the Whitefield micro-market.

# Project Highlights

- Low-density development with only 38% ground coverage, ensuring wide open spaces and unobstructed ventilation.
- 7 architecturally distinct towers connected by a central landscaped promenade and water-themed plaza.
- 100% power backup for common areas and essential apartment loads including lifts, lighting, and water pumps.

# Eco-Friendly and Safety Infrastructure

# Water Management

The community operates a fully automated Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) with a capacity of 450 kilolitres per day (KLD), sufficient to treat 100 percent of the wastewater generated on-site. Treated water is reused for landscape irrigation, flushing, and road washing, significantly reducing dependency on Cauvery water supply and borewells. Additionally, rainwater harvesting structures with a combined recharge capacity of 120,000 litres have been installed across the property, replenishing groundwater tables and supplementing the borewell network during the dry season.

# Solar Energy Usage

A 250 kWp rooftop solar photovoltaic installation spans the terraces of all seven towers, generating clean energy that powers common area lighting, lift lobbies, garden pathways.

# Environmental Initiatives

and the clubhouse. This installation is estimated to offset approximately 310 tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions annually and reduces the common area electricity expenditure that would otherwise be borne by residents through maintenance charges.

# Waste Management

Green Valley Residency follows a strict source-segregation policy, with color-coded bins provided in every apartment for wet, dry, and hazardous waste. An organic waste converter (OWC) with a 500 kg per day capacity processes kitchen and garden waste into compost, which is used to nourish the landscaped gardens. Dry waste is channelled to authorised recyclers through a tie-up with a certified municipal waste management vendor.

# Fire Safety Systems

The project is equipped with a wet riser and down-comer firefighting system, automatic sprinklers in basements and common corridors, smoke and heat detectors in every apartment and lobby, manually operated fire alarm call points on every floor, and two fire refuge areas per tower positioned at alternating levels as mandated by the National Building Code of India. Fire tenders can access all towers via a dedicated 6-metre-wide fire lane encircling the property.

# Earthquake-Resistant Structure

The structural design follows IS 1893 seismic code provisions for Zone III, incorporating a raft foundation, shear walls at strategic locations, and ductile detailing of reinforced concrete members. The structural design has been certified by an independent structural engineering consultancy and is periodically audited during construction milestones.

# Smart Home Integration

Every apartment is pre-wired with home automation infrastructure enabling app-based control of main door locks, living room and bedroom lighting circuits, and video door phone integration with the main gate security system. Residents can grant temporary access codes to guests, domestic staff, or delivery personnel remotely through the Green Valley Residents' mobile application.

# Road and Transit Connectivity

Green Valley Residency enjoys direct frontage on Varthur Main Road, a major arterial connecting Whitefield to Sarjapur Road and Outer Ring Road, providing residents with multiple route options to reach various parts of the city while avoiding single-corridor congestion. The Outer Ring Road (ORR) junction is approximately 8 kilometres away, offering swift access to Marathahalli, HAL Airport Road, and Electronic City via the Elevated Expressway. The Namma Metro Purple Line extension to Whitefield, operational since 2023, has significantly reduced dependency on road transport for daily commuters, with the nearest station, Kadugodi Tree Park, being a short 8-minute drive or a 15-minute walk from the project gate.

Peak-hour traffic on Varthur Main Road and the ITPL Main Road corridor remains moderate to heavy between 8:30 AM and 10:30 AM, and again between 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM, consistent with the high concentration of IT employees commuting to nearby tech parks. However, the completion of the Metro Purple Line extension and the ongoing widening of Varthur Road to six lanes are expected to ease congestion considerably over the next two to three years.

# Upcoming Infrastructure Developments

- Namma Metro Purple Line further extension planning towards Whitefield KR Puram loop, improving last-mile connectivity.
- Peripheral Ring Road (PRR) project, expected to enhance connectivity between Whitefield, Hennur, and Tumkur Road corridors upon completion.
- Widening of Varthur Main Road to a six-lane carriageway with dedicated service roads, currently under execution by BBMP.
- Proposed satellite township development near Varthur Lake, expected to add further social infrastructure including schools and hospitals.
- Expansion of ITPL and EPIP Zone with new Grade-A office towers, expected to add over 3 million sq. ft. of commercial space by 2029.

# Employment Hubs Nearby

Whitefield hosts one of Bengaluru's largest concentrations of IT and technology employment, including International Tech Park Bengaluru (ITPL), the EPIP Zone housing campuses of major multinational corporations, Prestige Tech Park, Brigade Tech Gardens, and RMZ Ecoworld located a short drive away via Marathahalli. Collectively, these employment hubs house an estimated 250,000 working professionals, forming a strong and consistent base of rental and ownership demand for residential properties within a 5-kilometre radius of Green Valley Residency.

# Appreciation Potential

Whitefield has historically recorded property price appreciation of 8 to 11 percent annually over the past five years, driven by sustained IT sector expansion, metro connectivity, and limited availability of new land parcels for large-format residential development. Real estate analysts tracking the East Bengaluru corridor project continued appreciation in the range of 9 to 13 percent annually over the next five years, supported by the completion of the Peripheral Ring Road and further metro network expansion. Green Valley Residency, being one of the few remaining large-format gated communities with direct arterial road frontage in this micro-market, is well positioned to benefit from this sustained demand and infrastructure-led growth.

# Why Invest in Green Valley Residency

Whitefield's sustained IT sector growth, combined with improving metro connectivity and limited large-format land availability, makes Green Valley Residency a compelling investment opportunity. Rental yields in the Whitefield micro-market currently range between 3.2 and 3.8 percent annually, among the highest in Bengaluru, driven by strong demand from IT professionals seeking rental accommodation close to their workplace. A well-maintained 2 BHK apartment in this locality typically commands monthly rent between ₹28,000 and ₹35,000, while 3 BHK units command between ₹38,000 and ₹48,000 per month.

Based on historical appreciation trends in Whitefield and projected infrastructure developments including the Peripheral Ring Road and further metro expansion, industry analysts estimate capital appreciation of 40 to 55 percent over a five-year holding period for well-located gated communities such as Green Valley Residency. Target buyers for this project include IT and technology professionals seeking end-use homes, NRI investors seeking a stable asset in a high-growth corridor, and domestic investors seeking rental income combined with capital appreciation.

As with any real estate investment, prospective buyers should be aware of inherent risks, including potential construction delays, fluctuations in the broader real estate market, changes in interest rates affecting financing costs, and regulatory changes. # 6. Frequently Asked Questions

# Q: Is Green Valley Residency RERA approved?

A: Yes, the project is registered under Karnataka RERA with registration number PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/030624/006789. The RERA certificate and quarterly construction updates are available on the Karnataka RERA website and at the sales office.

# Q: Are pets allowed in the community?

A: Yes, Green Valley Residency is a pet-friendly community. Designated pet relief zones are provided in the landscaped garden areas, and residents are requested to follow the community's pet policy regarding leashing and waste disposal in common areas.

# Q: Is covered parking available for all apartments?

A: Yes, one covered car parking slot is included with every apartment. Additional covered parking slots can be purchased separately at ₹2,50,000 per slot, subject to availability.

# Q: Can Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) purchase apartments here?

A: Yes, NRIs are eligible to purchase residential property in India under the guidelines set by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA). The sales team assists NRI buyers with documentation, power of attorney processes, and repatriation guidance.

# Q: What banks provide home loans for this project?

A: The project is approved for home loan financing by State Bank of India, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, and LIC Housing Finance, among other lenders. The sales office can facilitate introductions to relationship managers at these banks.

# Q: Is there 24-hour security at the property?

A: Yes, the community is secured round the clock with trained security personnel, biometric and RFID access control at all tower entrances, CCTV surveillance of common areas and the perimeter, and a centralised security control room.

# Q: How far is the nearest metro station?

A: The nearest metro station is Kadugodi Tree Park Station on the Namma Metro Purple Line, located approximately 2.7 km from the project, roughly an 8-minute drive or a 15-minute walk.

# Q: What schools are located nearby?

Q: Is there dedicated visitor parking?

Q: What is the cancellation policy?
A: In the event of cancellation, the booking amount and applicable charges are refunded as per the terms outlined in the Agreement for Sale, in compliance with RERA guidelines. A processing fee may be deducted depending on the stage of cancellation.

Q: What apartment configurations are available?
A: Green Valley Residency offers 2 BHK apartments (1,100–1,250 sq. ft.), 3 BHK apartments (1,500–1,750 sq. ft.), and a limited number of 3 BHK + Study apartments (1,850–1,950 sq. ft.) exclusively in Tower G.

Q: Is the project earthquake resistant?
A: Yes, the structural design complies with IS 1893 seismic code provisions for Zone III, incorporating a raft foundation and shear walls, and has been certified by an independent structural engineering consultancy.

Q: What amenities are included in the clubhouse?
A: The 45,000 sq. ft. clubhouse includes a gymnasium, swimming pool, yoga hall, indoor games room, mini theatre, business lounge, library, café, and a multipurpose hall for events.

Q: Is the project Vaastu-compliant?
A: Yes, all apartment configurations at Green Valley Residency are designed in accordance with traditional Vaastu principles, including entrance orientation and kitchen placement.

Q: What is the carpet area versus super built-up area difference?
A: Carpet area refers to the usable floor area within the walls of the apartment, while super built-up area includes the carpet area plus a proportionate share of common areas such as lobbies, staircases, and amenity spaces. For example, a 3 BHK with 1,650 sq. ft. super built-up area typically has a carpet area of approximately 1,430 sq. ft.

Q: Are EV charging points available?
A: Yes, EV charging points are available in the basement parking levels on both a pay-per-use basis and as dedicated installations for residents who own electric vehicles.

Q: Is the property suitable for elderly residents?
A: Yes, the project includes ramps at all entrance lobbies, handrails in common corridors, wheelchair-accessible lifts, and a dedicated senior citizen park with low-impact exercise equipment and shaded seating.

Q: What is included in the GST calculation?
A: GST is applicable at 5% of the property value for under-construction apartments without input tax credit, in line with current government regulations. No GST is applicable once the project receives its completion certificate.

Q: Does the project have a dedicated sewage treatment plant?
A: Yes, a 450 KLD capacity Sewage Treatment Plant treats 100% of the wastewater generated on-site, which is then reused for landscaping, flushing, and road washing purposes.
